info.name: Koala Server-Side Account Ingestion Profile Ingestion API
Send profile-level batch events, identifies, and page views

params.name: publicApiKey
params.description: Your Koala workspace public API key

items.docs: Ingests a batch of events, identify calls, and/or page views tied to a single profile (visitor). Each request must include either a `profile_id` (UUID v4 read from the `ko_id` cookie) or an `email`. A maximum of 30 entries each of events, identifies, and page_views per request is enforced. All entries in a single request must belong to the same person.
